description: Get one Harness Engineering Handbook chapter, by id (e.g. 'HRN-001') or slug. Returns the full Markdown body plus its provenance and related ids. Use this once `search` or `list_handbook` has given you an id.

id.description: Chapter id like 'HRN-001', or its slug.

locale.description: Language of the returned body. Default: en.

name: get_handbook

body.description: Full Markdown body of the chapter.

evidence.description: Evidence-First provenance: weight claims by this.

fallback.description: True when the body is not in the requested locale.

how_to_cite.description: The citation, already formed — use it verbatim.

requested_locale.description: The locale that was asked for.

resolved_locale.description: The locale actually returned. Chapters are authored in English and translated; where a translation exists this equals the requested locale, and `fallback` says when it does not.

title: Get a Harness Engineering Handbook Chapter
